item.title: Claude Code Release Notes: Memory and Context Changes (2026)
item.description:
What are the Claude Code release notes for memory?

Claude Code’s memory is made of files (CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, rules) plus compaction, which shortens a long conversation when it nears the context limit. This page tracks the release notes that change how those parts behave. It covers the 11 newest GitHub releases, read on 2026-11-13, and skips releases that touch no memory or context behavior. Read again on 2026-11-19 for v2.1.329.
